proposition: All Demerzel state instances conform to their declared JSON schemas — specifically PDCA states (logic/kaizen-pdca-state.schema.json) and autonomous-loop states (logic/loop-state.schema.json)

supporting.claim: Personas (17/17), tetravalent beliefs (5/5), contract schemas (11/11 valid JSON Schema), and reconnaissance profiles (3/3) all conform to their schemas.

logic/kaizen-pdca-state.schema.json was rewritten to match real instance shape (cycle_phase, hypothesis, kaizen_kind, plan/do/check/act objects). All 8 state/pdca/*.pdca.json instances now validate successfully against the amended schema.

logic/loop-state.schema.json was relaxed to the minimal core shape emitted by scripts/run_afk_cycle.py (loop_id, goal, repo, status, iterations). Both state/loops/*.loop.json instances now validate successfully. The original rich governance fields (worker, reviewer, convergence, per-iteration governance_check) are intentionally preserved as optional and will be reintroduced when the emitter is upgraded.

contradicting.claim: All 8 state/pdca/*.pdca.json instances fail validation against kaizen-pdca-state.schema.json. Instances use fields cycle_phase/hypothesis/kaizen_kind and lack the schema-required proposition/model/phase/belief_state/iterations. The schema and instances have diverged.

Both state/loops/*.loop.json instances fail validation against loop-state.schema.json. Instances use loop_id/risk/repo/governance_mode while the schema requires id/risk_level/target_repo/worker/reviewer/current_iteration/convergence.
